audience_question: Which shuttle option meets the minimum range at the lowest upfront cost?
fit_rationale: Every shuttle option shares the same range, upfront-cost, and annual-energy criteria; a common table keeps exact values and units aligned while making the qualifying lowest-cost choice clear.
tradeoff: Including annual energy cost adds useful context but keeps the focus on upfront-cost eligibility rather than implying a lifecycle-cost winner.
caveats: Annual energy estimates assume 18,000 km of service per vehicle and exclude maintenance and charging-infrastructure costs.
All figures are estimates from the same procurement worksheet; no uncertainty ranges were provided.
Alder is the lowest upfront-cost option among those meeting 200 km, not necessarily best on every criterion.
